source_refs.note: Strain: a main subheading of 5.3 Stress, strain and Young's modulus, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 96-96.

blocks.text: Strain batata hai ke stress lagne par solid mein kitni deformation hui. Ek dimension (sirf lambai) mein deformation ho to strain lambai mein fractional change (asal lambai ke muqable change ka hissa) hai. Agar ΔL lambai mein change aur L₀ asal lambai ho (Fig. 5.3 (a)), to:

blocks.alt: Lambai L ki gulabi bar ko dono siron par force F bahar ki taraf khenchti hai. Dono siron se aage dotted drawings dikhate hain ke bar kitni khinchi.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3(a): Tensile strain (kitab ki Figure 5.3(a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text_alt: Strain (ε) = Change in length (ΔL) / Original length (L₀)   (5.2)

blocks.text: Strain do lambaiyon ki ratio (ek ka doosre se muqabla) hai, is liye is ki koi dimension aur koi unit nahi. Agar strain ε tensile stress σ (kheenchne wale stress) se ho to use tensile strain kehte hain; agar compressive stress σ (dabane wale stress) se ho to compressive strain.

blocks.alt: Ek cube ka drawing aur us ke andar chhota dashed cube. Laal teer F har face par andar dabate hain: oopar, neeche, baen, daen, aage aur peechhe. Wavy (lehrdar) lines ek face ko A, bahar wale cube ko Volume V aur andar wale dashed cube ko Volume V - delta V batati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3(b): Volumetric strain (kitab ki Figure 5.3(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Jab stress volume badle to har unit volume mein volume ki change ko volumetric strain kehte hain (Fig. 5.3 (b)):

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har face par barabar force F andar dabati hai, is liye cube ki shakal wahi rehti hai lekin volume V₀ se ghat kar V₀ − ΔV reh jata hai. Volumetric strain = ΔV/V₀.

Farz karein ek rigid body (sakht cheez jo shakal na badle) ke do aamne saamne faces ka faasla y hai (Fig. 5.3 (c)). Shear stress lagne se ek face Δx faasla phisal (slide ho) jata hai. Is se shear strain γ paida hota hai:

blocks.alt: Grey block jis ka neeche ka hissa jura hua hai, daen taraf jhuka hai. Us ki orange oopri surface A par force F daen taraf lagti hai. Jure kone se oonchai y ki seedhi khari line uthti hai; oopar ka kinara us se delta x aage phisal gaya hai, aur khari line aur tirchhe kinare ke beech angle (kona) theta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3(c): Shear strain (kitab ki Figure 5.3(c) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne equation 5.4 mein Δx/y aur tan θ ke beech “=” ka nishan nahi chhapa, is liye woh multiply jaisi lagti hai. Sahi equation γ = Δx/y = tan θ hai, kyun ke Fig. 5.3(c) mein tan θ = Δx/y hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wala face Δx phisalta hai jabke oonchai y hai; is liye tan θ = Δx/y. Chhote angle ke liye tan θ ≈ θ, is liye shear strain = θ.
Agar angle θ chhota ho aur radian mein napa jaye to tan θ ≈ θ, is liye:

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Is ka naam 19th century ke British scientist Thomas Young ke naam par hai, lekin yeh concept 1727 mein Leonhard Euler ne pesh kiya tha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne naam ghalat chhape hain: “Thames Young” ki jagah Thomas Young aur “Euller” ki jagah Euler hona chahiye.
